headline: Many Companies Set Dividend Record Dates, Expected to Pay Hundreds of Billions of VND
summary: Nearly 21 Vietnamese companies will pay cash dividends, with the highest rate at 50%. Some expect to pay more than VND 100 billion.
why: Dividends are cash payments to shareholders and are a key part of equity returns. Record dates determine which investors qualify for a payout.
